messages:
sienna: Quick thread  we need to finalize the public error contract for SDKs + console. PMs keep seeing raw internal codes in the UI.
josh: Agreed. Smaller contract surface = easier i18n and stable telemetry. Suggest 4 enums only.
meera: For i18n we must separate enum keys (stable) from display text. Never translate the enum. Display text comes from i18n keys.
sienna: Proposed enums: RETRYABLE, QUOTA_LIMIT, DEGRADED, ACTION_REQUIRED. Console maps these to i18n keys like error.retryable.short.
josh: API minimal fields: error_category (enum), ui_key (i18n key), retry_hint (retryable/no-retry), quota_reset_s (optional). Example literal for RFC: ```{"error_category":"QUOTA_LIMIT","ui_key":"error.quota.short","retry_hint":"no-retry","quota_reset_s":"900"}```
meera: Important: dashboards must tag metrics with error_category only. If we change ui strings later dashboards unaffected. We'll emit legacy_code during rollout for 21 days.
sienna: SDK behavior: if retry_hint=="retryable" SDKs retry once then backoff; if "no-retry" surface CTA. Include a small example snippet in SDK docs showing header usage: `X-Error-Category: QUOTA_LIMIT` and `X-Fallback-Source: model-legacy-v1`.
josh: Also add a tiny machine hint can_fallback: true/false for routing decisions (not shown to users).
meera: Tooltip copy suggestion (en): "Transient errors: we'll retry briefly. If this repeats, contact support." keep <100 chars and use i18n.
docs-bot: notice: RFC draft opened at github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/512 - please review. :sparkles:
sienna: Rollout: feature flag client_error_v3, emit both legacy and new tags for 21 days, dashboards owners to verify. After 21 days flip console to i18n keys.
josh: Also update the alerting playbook to use error_category filters so on-call isn't alarmed by QUOTA_LIMIT badges (blue).
meera: I'll add the mapping table for legacy -> enums and the short i18n strings to the RFC.
sienna: Great. If no objections I'll merge RFC in 24h and start the canary schedule.
